access_notes: Not accessed. A search summary reports the museum catalogues it as a historical-literary text concerning Amel-Marduk (Grayson, BHLT pp. 87–92), and that some (Wiseman; a JETS article by Ferguson, 1994) read parts as referring to Nebuchadnezzar. None of this was verified at source.
